name: Cloud DLP Re-identification
description: Cloud DLP can de-identify sensitive fields so analysts can work with safer copies. The same product can re-identify those fields if someone has the right job. An attacker who can re-identify is turning masked data back into real names, numbers, or secrets. That undoes the privacy control without stealing the original database. Re-identify jobs outside a documented privacy workflow are data exposure.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
